layers.name: Countries hosting 1 million or more migrants

metadata.description: Migration: the 250 largest country-to-country corridors of international migrants living abroad in mid-2024, by country of birth and country of residence (UN DESA International Migrant Stock 2024), drawn as great circles sized by migrants and colored by destination region. White dots mark countries hosting at least one million migrants.
